title: Zone Seeds and Ignored Objects
description: Define seeds and ignored objects for different zones. For part class based zone seeds and ignored objects, add a zone_seeds.json file in the part class folder.

$schema.description: Path to the zone seeds and ignored objects json schema

^[0-9]+$.description: Zone ID: Mapped directly from profile info::zone type dropdown

seeds.description: List of initial joint configurations for optimization and solving reachability

items.description: A seed candidate represented by a 6-dimensional robot joint array, in radians

rollerSeeds.description: List of initial roller configurations for optimization and solving reachability

items.description: A seed candidate represented by a 1-dimensional roller array, in radians

ignoredEnvObjects.description: List of environment objects to ignore during collision checks by trajectory planner

items.description: Environment object name, must match the name specified in scene config
